title: Kali Ram v. State of Himachal Pradesh

content.caseIdentity: Kali Ram v. State of Himachal Pradesh, (1973) 2 SCC 808
content.holding: Reaffirmed the golden thread of criminal jurisprudence: the prosecution carries the unwavering legal burden under Section 104 to prove guilt beyond reasonable doubt; if two reasonable views are possible, the view favourable to the accused must prevail.
content.relevance: Mandatory citation in criminal appeals challenging convictions resting on speculative inferences.
